initialization.title: Starting up
initialization.explanation: The Docker container is being created and the runtime environment is initializing. The Tenstorrent drivers are loading and verifying your hardware is ready to receive work.

setup.title: Configuring the inference server
setup.explanation: The API server is starting and loading its configuration. It's reading your model's settings — quantization format, context length, parallelism strategy — so it knows how to slice the work across Tensix cores.

model_preparation.title: Loading model weights
model_preparation.explanation: The model's billions of learned parameters are being read from disk and transferred to the chip's SRAM over PCIe. A 70B model weighs ~35 GB in 4-bit format — this is why large models take longer here.
model_preparation.duration_hint: 30s – several hours if downloading for the first time

container_setup.title: Compiling execution graphs
container_setup.explanation: TT Metal compiles separate execution graphs for 10 different context lengths — from 128 to 65,000+ tokens. Once captured, every future inference replays a pre-built trace with zero Python overhead. This one-time cost makes all subsequent requests fast.

finalizing.title: Warming up
finalizing.explanation: The model is running a few silent test passes to pre-fill caches and ensure the hardware is at operating temperature. The first real request will be fast because this warmup already happened.

complete.title: Ready
complete.explanation: The model is live and accepting requests.
